name: Vector
description: Installs Vector and runs it as an s6-overlay service that hot-loads and unloads pipeline files from a well-known directory.

version.description: Vector release version to install. `latest` installs the current stable release.

serviceUser.description: User account that runs Vector and owns its pipeline directory. Automatic selection prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.

apiAddress.description: IPv4 or bracketed IPv6 address and port of the Vector API used by `vector top` and `vector tap`. `localhost` is normalized to `127.0.0.1`. Empty disables the API.

watchConfigMethod.description: How Vector watches its configuration: `recommended` (inotify on Linux) or `poll`, for hosts that have run out of inotify instances.

watchConfigPollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between configuration checks when `watchConfigMethod` is `poll`.
